content.comment_body: Hello, What is the correct endpoint to use when exporting data to an AWS web application? Should it be the 'thing' in AWS IoT? Best regards, [user_name]
Yes, it refers to your AWS account's device data endpoint. Log in to your AWS console. Go to IoT Core → Settings → Device Data Endpoint.

analysis.insight_summary: A user asks about the correct endpoint required to export data from [product_name] Web Editor to an AWS IoT web application. Another user clarifies where the relevant endpoint can be found in the AWS IoT console.
